newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes higher led by SPT and CEZ.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes higher led by SPT and CEZ.

text.p: Czech major issues SPT Telecom and CEZ gained strongly on Tuesday pushing the PX50 index on to a 0.5 percent gain to 570.5.
Dealers said that SPT had been driven higher by an acute shortage of supply which was reflected in relatively light trading during the continuous session.
"In CEZ there was some liquidity on the bid and offer side but...in SPT I saw hardly any supply and...no supply from abroad," said Radim Bajgar of ING Barings.
SPT rose 41 crowns to 3,466 and CEZ gained 20 crowns to 1,100.
Dealers and analysts say the Czech market is awaiting an anticipated influx of foreign capital making shareholders, especially those with major issues, reluctant to sell.
Elsewhere, Prazske Pivovary (PP) fell 10 crowns to 4,800. On Tuesday, Britain's Bass plc said it had completed a merger of PP and two regional breweries Ostravar and Vratislavice.

The statement said that the new company in which Bass holds a 55 percent stake will have a registered capital of 1.7 billion crowns which will be divided into shares with a nominal value of 100 crowns each.
